exact_formula: S(J(m,t))=2m for odd m in {1,3,5,7} and 1<=t<=12
method_note: Generic DSATUR symmetry searches aborted twice on larger uniform controls; partial rows were preserved. Final carrier/join rows use replayed explicit optimal colorings plus matching alpha-and-universal-clique lower certificates. The frozen operation and delta prediction were unchanged.
interpretation: Complete join is repelled from the Reed equality wall: its maximum-degree increase exceeds the combined chromatic/clique cancellation by exactly 2m.
